Respondent/s

 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Swapnil Kumar Singh, Advocate
 For the Respondent/s : Mr. Raj Kishore Roy, Gp-18
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Dr. Anshuman
 Oral Order
2 20-07-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for the State.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners is directed to add NHAI as respondent in course of the day.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners has filed the present writ petition directing the respondent to pay the adequate compensation as per the Government notification and rule fixed under Minimum Value Rate by the Government of Patna High Court CWJC No.3272 of 2023(2) dt.20-07-2023 Bihar.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners have received the compensation amount with objection.
He also submits that their land was acquired for the construction of four lane road at NH 80.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It has been submitted by the counsel for the State and counsel for the NHAI that since remedy lies of the petitioners against the grievances is before Arbitrator-cum- Divisional Commissioner,
Bhagalpur under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 [Act No. 48 of 1956].
5.

In that view of the matter, this writ petition is disposed off directing the petitioners to avail their remedy under the aforesaid provision of law before the Arbitrator-cum- Divisional Commissioner,
Bhagalpur.

(Dr. Anshuman, J.) ravishankar/-
